Kira CSM: quick post-smoke notes for Lagoon private/VPC onboarding — three small items: MTU, KMS grant, control-plane forwarding.
Omar Eng: what failed in smoke?
Kira CSM: 1) large artifact uploads hit packet fragmentation (MTU mismatch). 2) KMS Encrypt returned AccessDenied for ingest role. 3) a subset of control-plane events not arriving in Splunk.
Rae (Lagoon): we use MTU 9000 on our fabric, cluster default 1500.
Omar Eng: recommend MSS clamping at edge or set pod MTU if you can. Which can Lagoon do quicker?
Rae (Lagoon): MSS clamp is easier, ops can change tonight.
Priya Sec: for KMS add principal arn:aws:iam::888777666555:role/lagoon-ingest to CMK policy or create a Grant. Sample allowed actions: kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt,kms:GenerateDataKey*.
Rae (Lagoon): will apply grant and confirm.
Theo CE: control-plane filter used `redwood.aws` pattern; updated to include `api.redwood` too and redeployed subscription. CLI used: aws logs put-subscription-filter --log-group-name /redwood/lagoon/controlplane --filter-pattern '{($.eventSource = "redwood.amazonaws.com") || ($.eventSource = "api.redwood")}' --destination-arn arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:123456789012:destination:splunk-lagoon
Kira CSM: action items recap: 1) Lagoon ops -> enable MSS clamp and share tcpdump. 2) Lagoon sec -> apply CMK grant/policy and confirm no more 403s. 3) Theo -> monitor CP event delivery for 24h.
Rae (Lagoon): will update in 3h.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2755554321 completed for lagoon-priv (green) :white_check_mark:
Kira CSM: marking low-medium renewal watch until logs + KMS validated; scheduling enablement deep-dive next Tue. Thanks everyone.
